size_signals.signal: One organiser with a PO Box and a PHPList mailing list - a one-person operation, not a staffed studio
Rooms rented from IM Gallery; separate instructors (Jersey Tango, Renee George, Rainer Trubere) run each class and collect fees at the door
Site lists socials, workshops, videos and special events pages, so the calendar runs year-round

listing.platform: No Google rating found in search; only event listings (e.g. SwingEvents) and the site itself

website_review.online_booking_or_quote: none - no registration, no payment; students contact each instructor by email or cell and pay cash/Venmo/Zelle at the door
website_review.trust_signals: Photos and a video page of real classes and socials, long-running event calendar, mailing list with years of history
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Hand-built .htm pages in windows-1252 encoding with broken characters (stray '�'), keyword-stuffed meta description, no copyright line, an affiliate banner ad for DanceVision, phone not a tel: link, plain unstyled text layout
website_review.search_basics: Home title is 'Welcome to Highland Park Dance' with no service or town qualifier; meta description is a keyword list; separate pages per section (Classes, Events, Fitness, Videos, Location); zero JSON-LD
top_issues: No online registration or payment - each instructor handles sign-ups by personal email or cell
Site looks abandoned (mojibake text, no styling, affiliate banner) which undercuts a live events calendar
No Google Business Profile or reviews found, and no phone link for mobile users

agent_readiness.notes: Class times, venues, parking notes and most fees are real text, so a crawler can read them - but the page is served in windows-1252 with mojibake, one fee says 'contact Sandra for more information', and there is no schema (0 ld+json), no Google profile rating we could find, and /robots.txt only sets a 30-second crawl delay. Nobody can book or pay online; instructors are reached by personal email or cell.

operations_signals.signal: Class listings, fees and instructor contacts are hand-edited HTML, and each new session (e.g. a 4-week tango series starting 8 Oct 2026) has to be typed in manually
Payments are taken in cash, Venmo or Zelle at the door, per instructor - no central registration or attendance record
Mailing list runs on a bare PHPList subscribe form; no automated reminders or follow-up visible

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the hand-coded pages with a simple site plus online class registration and payment, so sign-ups stop going to individual instructors' phones
top_opportunities.evidence: Classes page tells students to email or call each instructor and pay at the door; no booking of any kind online

top_opportunities.opportunity: Set up a proper Google Business Profile and LocalBusiness/Event schema so the socials and classes are findable in search and AI answers
top_opportunities.evidence: No rating found in search; zero JSON-LD; robots only sets crawl-delay 30

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated class reminders and a modern email list replacing the PHPList subscribe page
top_opportunities.evidence: Mailing list is a bare subscribe form with no visible automation

scores.reasons: Nearly everything customer-facing is missing (no booking, no payment, no GBP, decaying HTML), but this is a one-person organiser collecting fees at the door, so budget is very thin; a rebuild is mostly cookie-cutter work; the site, classes page and robots were inspected directly.

caveats: Ratings come from third-party profiles that mirror Google (Birdeye, Loc8NearMe, Magicpin, LocalityBiz) or from Zocdoc for Positive Growth Counseling; Google Business Profile completeness could not be checked directly for any business.

Highland Park Dance was kept because it is a private dance-class and socials business, not a K-12 or higher-education institution; if the exclusion rule for 'school' is meant to cover dance schools, treat it as excluded.
Vagaro (Be Beauty) and judioshinsky.com returned bot/security blocks to this network, so their visual layout could not be judged at desktop or phone width.
data_gaps: Be Beauty: Vagaro returned Imperva 'Access denied Error 15' at desktop and phone width; services, prices and hours could not be verified from the platform itself.

Judi Oshinsky Psychotherapy: every page returned '403 Unauthorized' in Chrome (desktop and 390px); content was only readable through a different fetcher, so mobile layout and any 'schedule online' link target are unverified.
No Google Business Profile inspection was possible (Google Maps not accessible without consent/login), so profile completeness and review counts are reported from third-party mirrors.
Best Barbershop's site is offline, so its service list and prices come only from search-engine snippets of the former site, not from a page we could open.
